title: factdiff review items are judged in batches by a no-tool structured-output call, and only contradicted or undecided facts go to an agent group
goal: A census command (census.py judge LOG or factdiff.py review --judge) sends factdiff review items, each a fact with its old and new passage, in batches to one model call per batch with no tools and a JSON Schema result (supported, contradicted or not enough information per fact, with the sentence that decides it), through claude -p --output-format json --json-schema with --max-budget-usd [DOC S1800, S1824] (not the Message Batches API: it authenticates with an x-api-key header [DOC S-osulh6sh] the clone does not hold), on a pinned default model, claude-sonnet-5-5 [DOC S-ezqg74ki], which ST-jkehwsu4 later measures Haiku 5.5 against, and a batch size the item records as a provisional gate; a source whose every fact is supported is recorded confirmed with no agent; the rest go to census.py groups with only their undecided facts; each call's total_cost_usd and tokens are recorded in the census.phase ops row; the suite tests it with a stub in place of the model call, never a paid run; --dry-run prints the batch count and the estimated tokens and USD from the queue block.

gates.question: How many review items does one judge call hold, and how is a call's spend capped?
options: 20 items or 24,000 characters of passages a call, whichever comes first; each call's --max-budget-usd is 3 times its estimate, at least 0.05 USD
10 items or 12,000 characters a call; the cap is 2 times the estimate
40 items or 48,000 characters a call; the cap is 5 times the estimate
gates.recommendation: 20 items or 24,000 characters of passages a call, whichever comes first; each call's --max-budget-usd is 3 times its estimate, at least 0.05 USD
gates.answer: 20 items or 24,000 characters of passages a call, whichever comes first; each call's --max-budget-usd is 3 times its estimate, at least 0.05 USD

gates.question: Where are the judge verdicts kept so groups and brief can leave supported facts out?
options: _census/judge-<date>.csv beside the census log, committed with it (one row per fact: source_id, fact, path, verdict, sentence, model, note)
a cache file under _cache/census/, never committed
gates.recommendation: _census/judge-<date>.csv beside the census log, committed with it (one row per fact: source_id, fact, path, verdict, sentence, model, note)
gates.answer: _census/judge-<date>.csv beside the census log, committed with it (one row per fact: source_id, fact, path, verdict, sentence, model, note)

gates.question: Which verdicts and items are trusted without an agent?
options: A supported verdict counts only when its sentence is found in the new passage (else not enough information); an item with no new passage and every pinned-file row is never sent
Every supported verdict counts as given; items with no new passage are sent too
gates.recommendation: A supported verdict counts only when its sentence is found in the new passage (else not enough information); an item with no new passage and every pinned-file row is never sent
gates.answer: A supported verdict counts only when its sentence is found in the new passage (else not enough information); an item with no new passage and every pinned-file row is never sent

notes: Evidence: kb/_self/reports/fact-diff.md's entra dry run gave 43 review items in 24,212 characters (about 6k tokens) against 750,943 characters (about 190k tokens) for the changed pages, and each item is self-contained (fact, old passage, new passage), so it needs no tools and no agent loop. Product facts: claude -p --json-schema with --output-format json validates the result into structured_output, and the JSON names total_cost_usd (public/claude/ci-and-headless.md:34, :72, S1800); --max-budget-usd caps print-mode spend (public/agents/headless-agent-runtimes.md:52, S1824); Message Batches cost 50% of standard pricing, most finish within 1 hour, 24-hour expiry (public/claude/messages-api.md:88, :91, S-3pftmimx), but need an API key the clone may not hold, which the research story settles. Open for the research story (no operator gate, per the session that filed this): the model (Haiku or Sonnet), the batch size, and the agreement bar against a held-out set of review items judged by the current route. A paid run is dry-run first and its cap set from the estimate. Its default model is provisional: ST-jkehwsu4 measures Haiku 5.5 against it on held-out items and switches the default when Haiku holds the bars. 2026-10-11 orchestrator (operator's delegate): route set before the claim to claude -p, since the Messages API needs an x-api-key (public/claude/messages-api.md:28) and the clone's environment has no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; default model claude-sonnet-5-5, provisional for ST-jkehwsu4; the research story ST-7yh6lbh6 runs in parallel and its findings may revise the default.
